$description: FileRow (platform/components/FileRow), library wave 11, lane A: its component tokens. The row’s height, padding, gaps and the line under it; the hover and selected fills; the cells (their widths, color and type; sizes and dates in the data font); the transfer’s bar width and percent; the error’s color and icon; the actions’ gap.

file-row-hover-background.$description: FileRow: row fill under the pointer (state-hover).

file-row-border-color.$description: FileRow: the line under each row and above the list (border-divider).

file-row-gap.$description: FileRow: gap between the row’s parts (space-inline-md).

file-row-padding-block.$description: FileRow: row padding top and bottom (space-inset-xs).

file-row-padding-inline.$description: FileRow: row padding at the start and end (space-inset-sm).

file-row-actions-padding-inline-end.$description: FileRow: padding at the end of a row with actions: the ghost buttons bring their own (space-inset-xs).

file-row-cell-text.$description: FileRow: cell color: size, date, owner, percent (content-muted).

file-row-data-font-family.$description: FileRow: sizes, dates and the percent: the data font (font-data).

file-row-size-width.$description: FileRow: size cell width, room for a folder’s count (size-100px).

file-row-progress-gap.$description: FileRow: gap between the bar and its percent, and the error icon and its reason (space-inline-sm).

file-row-error-text.$description: FileRow: error icon and reason color (feedback-danger-content).
